commons.title: Atlas Van der Hagen-KW1049B10 029-LIVONIA Vulgo Lyetland.jpeg
commons.description: This map depicts the Baltic states Latvia and Estonia. Ever since the Treaty of Altmar in 1629 this area was a Swedish province which was mainly inhabited by Germans. The map was published in 1662 in the second volume of Joan Blaeus Atlas Maior. As a basis for this map, Blaeu used a large-size wall map from the Swedish scientist Anders Bureus (1571-1661), who was head of the topographical survey.
commons.editorial_reason: This is a historical regional map, not a visible cultural object or practice of the Livonians.
